before.subject: mathematics
before.question: Solve the following equations 4x – 3 = 3x + y = 2y + 5x – 12
before.ai_explanation: From 4x - 3 = 3x + y, we get x - 3 = y; from 3x + y = 2y + 5x - 12, we get -2x - y = -12; substituting y = x - 3 gives -2x - (x-3) = -12, so -3x = -9, thus x = 3... (rechecking: x=2, y=5 satisfies both equations).

after.subject: mathematics
after.question: Solve 4x − 3 = 3x + y = 2y + 5x − 12.
after.ai_explanation: Equating the first two expressions gives y = x − 3. Equating the last two gives 2x + y = 12. Substitute: 2x + x − 3 = 12, so x = 5 and y = 2. Check: all three expressions equal 17.

records.reasoning: Inspected original PDF page 2. Option A contains a stray leading 4 before x; the equation system uniquely gives x=5,y=2. Removed that typographical artifact, selected A and replaced incorrect stored explanation. No new distractors invented.
